name: Add on for Sendinblue on Wpforms
author: Muzammil

sections.description:
WPForm Sendinblue(Brevo) Add On developed for integrate SendinBlue(Brevo) API.
Using API send data from website to SendinBlue(Brevo) API.
Used Brevo API Version 3(V3)

Requirements

General Features Your Installed WordPress Version Must be a Current Verion 6.2 or More.

Required to Activate WPForm before Install this Plugin..

Require an Authentication Key from Your Brevo Account…

Third Party Compatibility

The vast majority of plugins and themes are compatible with Add on for Sendinblue(Brevo) on WPForm. [Our API]

Privacy

This plugin includes some suggested text that you can add to your site’s Privacy Policy via the Guide in the WordPress Privacy settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload \’sendinblue-add-on-gf.php\’ to the \’/wp-content/plugins/\’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress
sections.changelog:
1.0 Initial release

1.1 Updated and tested wordpress version up to 6.8.1
